method.gmli: mean leverage index at the reliever's game-entry play, self-computed from the StatsAPI winProbability feed (mlb_leverage); start games are dropped from the fold, openers excluded from the pool
method.pool: bullpen_export.load_season_pitching rows -> rem_plus.is_true_reliever and not _is_opener (score_pool parity)
method.qualification: Y->Y+1 pairs: TBF >= 100 in year Y and TBF >= 60 in year Y+1, gmLI present both years (rem_plus_backtest convention)
method.excluded: 2020 (60-game COVID season), so no 2019->2020 or 2020->2021 pair
method.pooling: season-pair samples pooled directly; gmLI is centered near 1.0 every season by construction, so cross-season pooling does not need re-centering
method.split_half: halves split at 06-30; both halves need >= 8 relief entries; pool = season-qualified (TBF >= 100) true relievers
method.gate: pre-registered: pooled Y->Y+1 Spearman rho >= 0.3; split-half bar pre-set to pooled within-season rho >= 0.3 before the run (the registered gate left it qualitative)
method.role: DEPLOYMENT CONTEXT metric; never folded into REM+ (two-number design validated in data/rem_plus_eval.json)

split_half_within_season.convention: halves split at 06-30; both halves need >= 8 relief entries; pool = season-qualified (TBF >= 100) true relievers

gate.verdict: PASS: gmLI is a stable deployment trait (pooled Y->Y+1 rho 0.4683 >= 0.3, split-half rho 0.5294 >= 0.3); ship as a context column per the registered ship path

proposed_values.definition: Relief-entry-weighted mean gmLI over [2024, 2025, 2026] (start games excluded from the fold). pct is the percentile within the current qualified pool. tag is 'established' with 2+ seasons and 60+ relief entries, else 'provisional'.
proposed_values.never_in_rem_plus: deployment context only; by design this number is never folded into the REM+ skill scale
